title: Saahlinda Naay Museum

services.name: Exhibition Tours
services.desc: The Haida Gwaii Museum and Haida Repatriation Committee work hard to build relationships with institutions and households around the world. Within this pursuit, we also work hard to locate, research and repatriate our Ancestors and Belongings. We don’t seek to repatriate contemporary Haida art that was made/sold under free prior informed consent. However, we are grateful to our growing group of friends that have been gifting our museum with extraordinary contemporary Haida artworks over the past few years. From these global relationships, we are thrilled to share two galleries full of beautiful Haida treasures - physical evidence proving that relationships built on mutual respect,

blurb: Saahlinda Naay - the Haida Gwaii Museum offers a fascinating look into Haida Gwaii culture from diverse perspectives where Haida knowledge, western science art and politics all blend together in a fluid and constantly changing context.
